current_text: To reset another user's code, use the User Directory section below (admin only). All resets are audited by the backend.
proposed_text: To reset another user's code, use the User Directory section below (admin only). All resets are recorded in the audit log.
reason: Jargon term 'backend' -- a Training Officer has no concept of a backend; 'audit log' names the actual visible feature that records it.

current_text: Select a user to reset their access code. The backend enforces scope; you can only reset users within your authorised unit. The old code is not recoverable.
proposed_text: Select a user to reset their access code. You can only reset users within your authorised unit. The old code cannot be recovered.

current_text: Immutable record of actions — backend authoritative
proposed_text: Permanent record of actions. It cannot be edited or deleted.
reason: 'Immutable' and 'backend authoritative' are both jargon; the plain rewrite states the same guarantee (why the record can be trusted) without software terms.

current_text: Upload the AAFC training schedule workbook (.xlsm) to import all curriculum items from zz - Program backend. Idempotent — safe to run multiple times.
proposed_text: Upload the AAFC training schedule workbook (.xlsm) to import all curriculum items from zz - Program backend. Safe to run multiple times without creating duplicates.

The 'zz - Program backend' reference is left unchanged -- it names an actual worksheet tab in the uploaded file, not a terminology choice, so the user needs that exact literal name to find it.
